top.description: Player 1 background (Rick + Morty). Formato cuadrado 1:1, personajes a los lados, centro abierto.
top.prompt: A detailed 2D cartoon illustration in the iconic Rick and Morty art style, square format 1:1. A single continuous, seamless, and unified garage laboratory scenery filled with shelves of glowing experiment jars, wires, and a drawing board, spanning the entire width. On the left side of this same laboratory stands Rick Sanchez with wild blue hair, holding his portal gun, surrounded by a soft green dimensional portal aura. On the right side of this same laboratory stands Morty Smith with an anxious, sweaty expression, holding a laser blaster. Both characters are naturally integrated into the same single-picture scenery and are drawn slightly smaller to fit entirely within the frame with a safe margin from the outer edges. The center of the laboratory is empty and clean. No split screen, no vertical dividers, no black bars, no empty black columns, no black panels. --ar 1:1 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, cropped characters, split screen, black bars, vertical dividers, black columns, black panels

Both characters are naturally integrated into the same single-picture scenery and are drawn slightly smaller to fit entirely within the frame with a safe margin from the outer edges. loader.description: Pantalla de carga: Rick vs Morty jugando una partida REAL y correcta de Magic. Vertical 9:16 mobile.
loader.prompt: A humorous 2D cartoon scene of a card match in the classic Rick and Morty style, vertical portrait composition, aspect ratio 9:16. Rick Sanchez and Morty Smith are seated properly and facing each other across a wooden workbench in Rick's messy garage laboratory, playing a game of Magic. Rick has a crazy grin, holding his cards and a flask, while Morty looks nervous and sweat-drenched studying his hand. Both characters hold their cards facing themselves (only the card backs are visible to the camera). On the table, a detailed Magic: The Gathering card layout is displayed: rows of fantasy cards with some cards turned horizontally at 90-degrees to indicate they are tapped, next to a glowing green portal gun and sci-fi tools. Warm workbench lighting, green portal glow at the back. Flat cel-shading, bold outlines. --ar 9:16 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, backward cards
